set.body: Before v0.65 implementation, specify the acyclic module/API arrangement for VersionedCodec[A], NodeDef[P], typed extension registration, artifact references, schema ids/versions, conditional codecs for Trials[K,M,A] and Timeline[A], entry-array map encoding, and duplicate-key rejection. Preserve the settled rule that plan params are typed values, never string bags. This closes the unstated generic-codec prerequisite without introducing a plan<->codec dependency cycle.
set.title: Finalize the plan/codec seam for generic typed parameters
